identity.label: Stable Audio 3
identity.description: Family of latent diffusion models for text-to-audio music and sound-effect generation, audio-to-audio editing, inpainting, and continuation.
identity.parameter_count: 433M small music/SFX checkpoints; 1.4B medium checkpoint in the official repo table
identity.model_format: safetensors; MLX .npz optimized weights; ONNX/CoreML optimized variants also published
identity.dtype: mixed: DiT fp16 in MLX, decoder fp32, T5Gemma fp16

benchmark.tested_on_hardware: Not benchmarked in Vox Jot; upstream MLX README includes an M4 Pro / 48 GB sample run
benchmark.output_quality_notes: Promising for a Vox Jot Studio creative-audio lane: music beds, atmospheres, transitions, Foley, and sound effects for scripts/stories. It does not produce spoken readback or transcription output.

blockers: Requires a new Vox Jot Studio creative-audio product surface; it should not be inserted into STT or TTS rankings
Gated/community license with an enterprise-license threshold for organizations above Stability AI's revenue limit
Needs an app-managed MLX sidecar/runtime and large resumable model downloads before normal users can rely on it
No Vox Jot benchmark suite exists yet for prompt adherence, loop quality, SFX usefulness, generation latency, cancellation, or output export behavior
verdict.notes: Recommended path: prototype behind Labs/Studio using the official optimized/mlx implementation, start with sm-sfx and sm-music, keep medium optional, and build an app-managed download/runtime flow. Existing dictation, transcription, and readback hot paths should not load or initialize this runtime.
